channel.title: codeonholiday Blog
channel.description: Notes on building small, focused macOS apps.

item.title: Meet HoverBoard — The Quiet Layer Between You and Your Screen
item.description: HoverBoard is a native macOS menu bar app for presenting, teaching, and demoing without breaking your flow. Draw, explain, record, transcribe, and follow up from one hotkey-driven workspace.

item.title: How to Use HoverBoard Whiteboard — Mindmaps, Diagrams, and Teaching Widgets
item.description: A detailed guide to HoverBoard Whiteboard: infinite canvas, mindmaps, connectors, sticky notes, checklists, media links, architecture stencils, and exports on macOS.

item.title: How to Use HoverBoard Spotlight — Focus Attention on One Area
item.description: Learn how HoverBoard Spotlight dims the screen around your cursor, how to tune radius and feathering, and how to keep presenting with click-through on macOS.

item.title: How to Use HoverBoard Sessions — Build a Deck While You Present
item.description: Learn how HoverBoard Sessions captures frames from Draw, Freeze, and Whiteboard, how to reorder and rename them, and how to export PNG sets or PDFs on macOS.

item.title: How to Use HoverBoard Notes — Private Markdown for Presenters
item.description: Learn how HoverBoard Notes keeps speaker notes private by default with Markdown, live preview, Mermaid diagrams, search, folders, autosave, presenter mode, and PDF export on macOS.

item.title: How to Use HoverBoard Keystroke Display — Show Shortcuts Live
item.description: Learn how HoverBoard Keystroke Display shows modifier chords and app shortcuts on screen, how to grant Input Monitoring permission, and how to present safely.

item.title: How to Use HoverBoard Freeze & Explain — Pause the Screen and Teach Clearly
item.description: Learn how HoverBoard Freeze captures a screen snapshot for calm step-by-step explanations, annotations, session capture, and live presenting on macOS.

item.title: How to Use HoverBoard Draw — Annotate Any Screen on macOS
item.description: Learn how to use HoverBoard Draw for live annotations, arrows, shapes, number markers, colors, auto-fade, and click-through presenting on macOS.

item.title: How to Use HoverBoard Cursor Halo — Make Your Pointer Easy to Follow
item.description: Learn how to use HoverBoard Cursor Halo for cursor visibility, click ripples, color and size customization, and clearer screen sharing on macOS.

item.title: How to Use HoverBoard Break Timer — Keep Workshops on Schedule
item.description: Learn how to run HoverBoard Break Timer with fullscreen or minimal overlays, custom messages, chimes, pause, and live time adjustments on macOS.

item.title: How to Use HoverBoard — A Complete Guide
item.description: Install HoverBoard, use Draw, Spotlight, Freeze, Whiteboard, private Notes, Break Timer, Cursor Halo, Keystroke Display, and Sessions, learn hotkeys, free vs Pro, and Stream Deck URLs on macOS.

item.title: How to Use Meetly — A Complete Guide
item.description: Install Meetly, set up calendars, use the fullscreen reminder, Quick Panel, keyboard shortcuts, mute, and Pro features. Everything you need to never miss a meeting on macOS.

item.title: I Kept Missing Daily Standup. So I Built Meetly.
item.description: Calendar notifications weren’t enough. Here’s why I built Meetly — a macOS fullscreen meeting reminder that finally made daily standup unmissable.

item.title: Presenting Meant Switching Apps. So I Built HoverBoard.
item.description: Annotating live on macOS meant quitting the share, opening another tool, and killing the room’s focus. Here’s why I built HoverBoard — draw, spotlight, freeze, and more, a hotkey away.
